description: The active Chargeback configuration rows (chargeback_config for Elastic Cloud ECU, chargeback_config_onprem for On-Premises mERU): currency rate and unit, blended cost weights (indexing, query, storage), utilization weights and floor, and the validity window. If empty on an assets-only install without Fleet config sync, Chargeback applies defaults (0.85 EUR per ECU, 0.00085 EUR per mERU, blended weights 20/20/40, utilization weights 70/30, floor 0.10). Read this before explaining or justifying any number.

configuration.query:
FROM chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf
| KEEP config_join_key, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_indexing_weight, conf_query_weight, conf_storage_weight, conf_utilization_memory_weight, conf_utilization_storage_weight, conf_utilization_floor, conf_start_date, conf_end_date
| LIMIT 10
